name: NDJIR
aliases: NDJIR (Neural Direct and Joint Inverse Rendering)
Neural Direct and Joint Inverse Rendering
definition: A method for inverse rendering that jointly decomposes geometry (SDF), lights (environment and implicit), and materials (base color, roughness, specular reflectance) by directly addressing the integrals in the rendering equation using volume rendering, avoiding approximations like Spherical Gaussians or split-sum.
summary: NDJIR is an inverse rendering method that jointly decomposes geometry, lighting, and materials by directly computing physically-based rendering integrals within a volume rendering pipeline, avoiding common approximations.
